title: Tankers Still Burn in Hormuz Despite De-escalation Hopes
en: In the Strait of Hormuz, tankers are still ablaze and oil spills are washing ashore, despite expectations of a de-escalation reflected in falling oil prices. The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency reported another incident involving a tanker on Wednesday, while Iran said a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine. At least 10 ships were hit in the first 10 days of November, after 37 attacks in October, the highest monthly tally since the conflict began, according to the Washington Institute for Near East Policy. The International Maritime Organization has confirmed 133 incidents in the region since the conflict began in late February, with at least 25 seafarers killed.
zh: 尽管油价回落反映出局势降级的预期，霍尔木兹海峡的油轮仍在燃烧，浮油正被冲上海岸。英国海上贸易运营办公室周三报告了又一起涉及油轮的事件，伊朗方面称一艘油轮触碰水雷后起火。据华盛顿近东政策研究所数据，在10月发生37起袭击（开战以来单月最高）之后，11月前10天又有至少10艘船只遇袭。国际海事组织确认，自2月底冲突爆发以来该地区已发生133起事件，至少25名海员丧生。

title: Oil Up 1% as Iran Says No Nuclear Material Will Leave
en: Oil prices rose about 1 percent on Wednesday after Iran's security chief said Tehran would not allow even a single particle of enriched nuclear material to leave the country, feeding supply worries that lifted prices off two-month lows. Brent futures settled 1.39 percent higher at $92.76 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate crude gained 0.57 percent to $86.53. The United States has said nuclear issues must be part of any initial negotiations aimed at ending the war. Oil prices are being supported by fading hopes of an imminent de-escalation, a UBS analyst said. Brent has still fallen about 21 percent since the start of the month on hopes of an end to the conflict.
zh: 伊朗安全负责人表示，德黑兰不会允许哪怕一粒浓缩核材料离开该国，供应担忧随之升温，油价周三上涨约1%，从前一交易日创下的两个月低点回升。布伦特原油期货收涨1.39%报每桶92.76美元，美国WTI原油涨0.57%报每桶86.53美元。美国已表示，核问题必须是旨在结束战争的任何初步谈判的一部分。一位瑞银分析师说，油价正受到「降级希望消退」的支撑。受战争结束预期影响，布伦特本月以来仍累计下跌约21%。
vocab: adj. 即将发生的；迫近的

title: EU Reaches Deal on 2027 Budget of 211.5 Billion Euros
en: The Council and the European Parliament secured agreement on the EU's annual budget for 2027, the seventh and final annual budget of the current multiannual financial framework for 2021-2027. The 2027 budget amounts to 199.7 billion euros in total commitments and 211.5 billion euros in total payments. The agreement safeguards the EU's ability to cope with ongoing crises such as those in Ukraine and the Middle East. Ireland's minister for finance, chief Council negotiator for the budget, said it would strike the right balance between acting decisively and avoiding additional burden on national budgets and taxpayers. The two institutions now have 14 days to formally approve the deal.
zh: 欧盟理事会与欧洲议会就2027年欧盟年度预算达成协议，这是2021至2027年多年期财政框架下第七份也是最后一份年度预算。2027年预算总承诺额为1997亿欧元，支付总额为2115亿欧元。该协议保障了欧盟应对乌克兰和中东等持续危机的能力。担任理事会首席谈判代表的爱尔兰财政部长表示，预算将在果断行动与避免加重成员国预算及纳税人负担之间取得恰当平衡。两大机构现在有14天时间正式批准该协议。

title: Runaway Bus Hits 32 Vehicles in South Korea, 57 Injured
en: A city bus plowed into more than 30 vehicles waiting at a traffic stop in Seongnam, just south of Seoul, during morning rush hour on Wednesday, leaving 57 people injured. The bus, driven by a man in his 60s, struck four other buses, a cargo truck and 27 passenger cars over a stretch of about 150 meters before crashing into a center median and coming to a halt. Nine people were seriously hurt and 48 suffered minor injuries, but none of the injuries were life-threatening. The driver reportedly told police that the brakes did not work. A breathalyzer test showed he was not under the influence of alcohol, and investigators plan to check whether he had taken drugs.
zh: 周三早高峰时段，一辆城市公交车在首尔以南的城南市冲入正在等待信号灯的车流，造成57人受伤。这辆由一名60多岁男子驾驶的公交车在约150米的路段内先后撞上4辆公交车、1辆货车和27辆轿车，最终撞上道路中央隔离带后停下。9人重伤、48人轻伤，均无生命危险。司机向警方表示当时刹车失灵；现场呼气酒精检测未发现酒驾，调查人员还计划检测其是否服用药物。
vocab: 动词短语 冲入；撞上
n. 刹车 v. 刹住

title: US Moves to Cut Food Stamps for 6.3 Million People
en: The Trump administration on Tuesday moved to cut millions more Americans from the nation's largest food assistance programme, even as enrolment continues to fall because of earlier cuts. A proposed rule issued by the US Department of Agriculture would curb automatic eligibility for SNAP benefits, known as food stamps, for households receiving cash aid under another programme. Under the change, nearly 18 percent of SNAP recipients, or about 6.3 million people, would lose benefits, and an estimated 1.8 million children would lose eligibility for free school meals. More than 5.5 million people have already lost benefits since 2025, bringing enrolment to about 36 million. The public will have 30 days to comment on the rule.
zh: 周二，特朗普政府推动将数百万美国人进一步剔除出全美最大的食品援助项目，而在此前一系列削减之后，参保人数已在持续下降。美国农业部发布的拟议新规将收紧领取另一项现金救助家庭的食品券（SNAP）自动资格认定。根据这一调整，近18%的SNAP领取者、约630万人将失去福利，预计另有180万儿童将失去免费校餐资格。自2025年以来已有超过550万人失去该项福利，参保人数降至约3600万。公众将有30天时间就该规则提交意见。
vocab: n. 参保人数；注册人数

title: CoreWeave Raises Forecast, Sparking an AI-led Rebound
en: US equities rose on Wednesday after AI cloud provider CoreWeave reported third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, up 168 percent from a year earlier, and lifted its 2026 revenue forecast to between $13 billion and $13.3 billion. Its contracted backlog stood at $132.5 billion, and the company said it did not intend to issue more parent-level unsecured debt through 2027. The report eased a month of anxiety about debt-financed AI infrastructure, and the shares jumped roughly 25 percent, leading a rebound across AI infrastructure names. Technology led a broader market gain, with the Nasdaq up 1.6 percent and the Philadelphia semiconductor index climbing more than 5 percent.
zh: 在AI云服务商CoreWeave公布三季度营收36.6亿美元、同比增长168%，并将2026年营收指引上调至130亿至133亿美元区间后，美股周三上涨。其积压订单达1325亿美元，公司并表示2027年前无意再发行母公司层面无担保债务。这份财报缓解了市场一个月来对债务驱动型AI基建的担忧，其股价单日大涨约25%，带动AI基础设施板块全线反弹。科技板块领涨大盘，纳指涨1.6%，费城半导体指数涨超5%。
